message: Hi Alex, it's Aisha at Pearl Dentistry, ok. Can you guarantee this gets me 30 more customers a month? I need a promise.
reply: Hi Aisha, honest answer: no, I can't promise a specific number of new customers — no one legitimately can. What I can do is fix real issues (speed, mobile, booking flow, broken forms) that typically hurt conversions. The $900 fix pack covers that, no guarantee attached. Happy to send the audit findings first so you can judge if it's worth it.
